result.title: PaMuk-Bench: A Parallel Multilingual Multitask Benchmark for Vision-Language Tasks
result.summary: While vision-language models (VLMs) currently obtain notable results for highly-studied languages, e.g. English, they exhibit significant performance drops in certain low-resource languages, especially due to the lack of annotated datasets. To this end, we propose PaMuk-Bench, a novel parallel multilingual multitask benchmark for vision-language tasks. Our benchmark includes a set of over 10K curated English prompts that are translated into six languages: Arabic, Danish, French, Hindi, Italian, Romanian. Parallel translations, which are obtained via a semi-automatic process, along with accompanying generated and retrieved images enable the comparative development and evaluation of VLMs across a wide range of tasks: text-to-image generation, image captioning, content-based image retrieval, image generation difficulty estimation, image retrieval difficulty estimation. We empirically show that zero-shot English and multilingual pre-trained VLMs compare consistently worse than their fine-tuned counterparts, confirming that PaMuk-Bench is a valuable resource that can drastically reduce the language gap across a variety of VLM architectures and tasks. PaMuk-Bench is available at https://github.com/ghesil/pamuk_bench.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 PaMuk-Bench：一个含六种语言平行翻译的万级多语言多任务视觉-语言基准，覆盖文生图、图像描述、图像检索与生成/检索难度估计，并对比零样本与微调 VLM。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作聚焦多语言覆盖与任务基准评测，未涉及视觉证据筛选、latent 状态生成与使用、动态计算或停止决策等具体机制，与 LVR 主线缺少可核查的实质联系。
